watch.summary: A streamer aggressively threatens an egg in a precision physics game, only for the egg to immediately fall off a ledge, leaving him in stunned silence.

beats.what: The streamer angrily declares he is no longer being positive about the game.
He threatens to eat the egg and its brothers if it falls one more time.
The egg bounces off a beam and plunges all the way down.
The streamer goes completely silent, staring in utter disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I will literally eat you and two more of your brothers. Try me.
watch.why: The instant karma of aggressively threatening an in-game egg right before it tumbles off a ledge creates a perfect hubris-before-a-fall punchline. His loud rant cut short by dead silence sells the failure brilliantly.
